Based on my reading of the codebase:

1. **Where is it guaranteed that no two articles share the same slug?**
   `prisma/schema.prisma :: Article.slug` (line 41)
   Database-level `@unique` constraint

2. **Where is it computed whether the requesting user follows an article's author?**
   `src/application/services/ArticleService.ts :: buildArticleResponse` (line 190-191)
   Calls `userRepository.isFollowing(currentUserId, article.authorId)`

3. **Where is the authentication token verified on incoming requests?**
   `src/presentation/middleware/AuthMiddleware.ts :: authenticate` (line 25)
   Calls `tokenService.verify(token)`
